title: I made a twin-stick shooter rogue-light set on a deadly 1980s game show. Is it fun?
author: wholikesgame
selftext:
https://wholikesgame.itch.io/ratings-war

I've been working on **Ratings War**, a twin-stick shooter rogue-lite where you're a contestant on the most dangerous show on TV. Inspired by the classic arcade game, Smash TV, 1-2 players fight through four seasons of rooms full of stage hazards. Between fights you pick upgrades and gamble your cash or lives on bonus rounds. Each season ends with a boss that gets harder the longer you take.

I'm looking for honest opinions, mainly: **is it fun?** I'd love to hear what grabbed you, what felt confusing, and where you stopped playing.  
One heads-up: I've only really playtested it with a controller. Keyboard and mouse work, but they haven't had much testing, so if you try it that way, I'd really like to hear how it felt.

You can play it in your browser here: [https://wholikesgame.itch.io/ratings-war](https://wholikesgame.itch.io/ratings-war)

Thanks for taking a look!

🎮 **Controller** (recommended)  
**Move:** left stick or D-pad  
**Aim and shoot:** right stick (or A / B / X / Y to shoot in four directions)  
**Dash:** LB or RB  
**Special:** LT or RT  
**Holster (swap to a power weapon):** click either stick  
**Pause / menu:** Start  
**Card picks:** left / right to choose, A to pick, Y to reroll  
**Player 2:** press Start on a second controller to join

⌨️** Keyboard and mous**e  
**Move:** WASD  
**Aim and shoot:** hold left mouse button (or arrow keys / IJKL)  
**Dash:** Space, Shift or right mouse button  
**Special:** Q or E  
**Holster:** R or Tab  
**Pause / menu:** Esc or P  
**Card picks:** A / D or arrow keys to choose, Enter or Space to pick, 1–4 to pick directly, R to reroll  
**Unlocks screen (on the title screen):** C  
**Fullscreen:** F
